frozen_specification.liquidity_sweep: Causal wick beyond last confirmed swing high/low then close back inside; bullish sweep: low < swing_low AND close > swing_low AND close >= open.
frozen_specification.fvg_definition: Strict 3-candle FVG at bar i: bullish if low[i] > high[i-2]; bearish if high[i] < low[i-2]. Mitigation tracked forward only.
frozen_specification.fvg_after_sweep: Entry bar i when (fresh OR partial FVG active at i) AND liquidity sweep occurred within bars i-0..i-3 (same causal rules as market_context_v11).
frozen_specification.entry_timing: Signal bar close; optional entry slippage stress only in robustness.
frozen_specification.stop_exit: V11 adaptive ATR exit (_adaptive_exit): initial 1.5×ATR stop, structure-break exit, ATR trail after 1R.
frozen_specification.cost_model: ROUND_TRIP_COST by asset_class × cost_mult (2× stress gate)
frozen_specification.tuning_policy: Frozen before expanded-history evaluation; no parameter changes on new data.

sources.suitability: PRIMARY for V12 extended intraday research
